item: Using technical commands (e.g., 'BFS head face swap') as the entire prompt
Specifying a medium (e.g., 'photograph', 'cinematography') that the model cannot perfectly replicate
Using LoRAs at very low scales (e.g., 0.5 or lower) where the effect may be absent
Overly complex prompts without clear structure or focus
Assuming LoRA effect is visible at small image sizes (e.g., 640x960)
